title: Google’s inevitable ‘Pixel Watch Ultra’ should copy the Fitbit Air
summary: It feels rather inevitable that Google will give in to the whole “Ultra” smartwatch fad, and when something along the lines of a “Pixel Watch Ultra” does arrive, I really hope it pulls influence from Fitbit Air.
